derivation: or rather (shortened) אֵלֹנִי; patron from H438 (אַלּוֹן);
def: an Elonite or descendant (collectively) of Elon

occurrences.text: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
